fixture_policy.independent_computations: Raw atoms, raw design rows, structural gradients, probability kernels, polynomial coefficients and numerical integrals are recomputed; retained narrative calculation/result strings are not used as expected numeric inputs. Numeric outputs are checked against authored finite witnesses or claimed finite inequalities. Gaussian/Laplace quadrature uses explicit finite grids and stated tolerances.
fixture_policy.invalid_selectors: Unknown fields, unsupported check/fixture, unsupported dimension and moment-value selectors fail. Only original descriptive metadata fields are accepted; they are not execution parameters. Four unsupported-selector mutations were rejected for each of 22 rows.
fixture_policy.limits: Finite fixtures are counterexample searches, not general proofs. No numerical calculation claims all-real Gaussian identities, Borel measurability, all finite epsilon, arbitrary local iteration counts, or general privacy/composition. Those remain in unchanged source proofs. In particular threshold check tests exact below/equal/above preimage witnesses plus finite pushforward privacy; zero-epsilon composition checks purified binary transcript losses and original-law TV.
